name: owasp-security-audit
description: Audits your codebase against the OWASP Top 10:2025 and produces an evidence-backed security report. Detects the actual stack and execution context, rates severity and confidence separately, masks secrets, and asks before running project or third-party code.

interface.longDescription: Audits your codebase against the OWASP Top 10:2025 and produces an evidence-backed security report. Detects the actual stack and execution context, rates severity and confidence separately, masks secrets, and asks before running project or third-party code.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository against the OWASP Top 10:2025.
